card.name: Nouns completing a compound or comparison
card.fires_on: The word right after a noun or quantity phrase in general web text, such as "time" in "class time" or "cells" after "number of germs... than we have". It is mostly the second noun of a compound or the end of a comparison.

modes.label: Compound noun ending
modes.description: The second noun of a compound like class time, grazing time or transition altitude.
modes.example: Playtime can be as important as class<< time>> for helping students perform their best.

modes.label: Comparison or count phrase
modes.description: A word completing a comparison or count such as number of, than, or have cells.
modes.example: will exceed the number<< of>> Native Speakers.
